    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Complete horizontal uniform lines delimit bands; their color is the
    # vertical separator color too, detectable across the remaining rows.
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1]
    sep=grid[rows[0]][0]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==sep for r in range(h) if r not in rows)]
    rb,re=[0]+[r+1 for r in rows],rows+[h]
    cb,ce=[0]+[c+1 for c in cols],cols+[w]
    marker=8 if 8 in sum(grid,[]) else 7
    bg=5 if marker==8 else 4
    # Presence of a marker indicates the opposite binary value.
    return [[bg if any(grid[r][c]==marker for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y)) else marker
             for x,y in zip(cb,ce)] for a,b in zip(rb,re)]
